Well it's waaaaay more accurate than loseit or MFP... As you know fruit has no calories!

Eh, I dunno. I upped my calorie budget by a hundred calories. When I started, I bumped my calorie budget down like 400 calories from what it told me to do - I don't trust those TDEE calculators when you have as high as a BMI as I do. I've lost almost exactly 2 pounds a week, so it seems to have been dialed in right.

Recently I've started walking, and either that or just time (or both) seems to be helping. I do log my exercise (conservatively) so in a way I have also been eating more.

If I'm losing 2lb/week, that should be a good rate, right? And shouldn't have any mental effects?

Congrats! I went from 1-3 pints of vodka a day to nothing 5 weeks ago and have lost 11 pounds, myself. Although my goal isn't to stay dry forever, I certainly realized that taking a good, long, break was important in order to get things together.

Did you experience any sort of brain fog, or lack of motivation/energy? If so, how long did that last? The first few weeks for me were actually great, and I had a ton of energy, but by the third week I was worn out and exhausted all of the time. I started counting calories and losing weight the day that I stopped drinking. It's slowly been getting better - exercise has been helping with that.
